notes:
• Server update: Ronin's server address has changed and the service is restored — if your channels don't load, sign in again with your usual username and password
• Loading screen: the Ronin logo + red loading bar now stay up until Home is fully loaded — no more opening onto Continue Watching tiles first
• Cold open: Home now opens at the top, on the hero
• Continue Watching: episodes tapped right after a cold start now play — the app fetches the show's episode list itself instead of needing you to open the show's page first
• Series theme music: a show's theme song now plays on its series screen, like on TV — toggle in Settings → Playback
• Live TV: your favourites folders now sit right in the sidebar, under Favorites — tap a folder to see its channels, hold to rename or delete
• Home: the Live TV recents row is removed — Continue Watching sits directly under the hero
